title: Q-REDTEAM-live-needs-js: /live serves only 'Loading...' without JavaScript, so crawlers, AI readers and no-JS visitors see no figures
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** red-team pass (REDTEAM-1), daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation redteam --probe
**Prediction:** redteam_found_30d <= 10 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** weakening the red-team check or editing page text by hand; fix the producer.
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation redteam --probe`
**Status:** closed

Found by reading production as a stranger on 2026-11-25. Root cause: client-only rendering. Fix the producer, not the page text. Closing probe: GET /live HTML contains at least one figure and its timestamp.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T03:14:49Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
